title: Rigetti Stock: Buy the Dip? | RGTI Stock Analysis
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions
summary: Parkevtate asks whether Rigetti Computing is a buying opportunity after a 57% fall in 2026 and roughly 80% off its ~$50 all-time high, and answers no. The positives are real: a 95.5% median two-qubit fidelity milestone and a $100m US government funding agreement, plus a strong balance sheet — over $383m of cash against about $4m of debt, raised by selling stock at euphoric 2025 valuations, so no near-term need to raise. But revenue is lumpy and inconsistent, the quantum industry is still very early with few enterprise use cases (most revenue comes from research institutions experimenting), and losses are massive at negative 500% operating cash flow to sales and negative 800% operating margin. At a forward P/E of 76 it still looks expensive, especially against rival IonQ at 13.5, which he calls the only quantum stock he currently ranks as a buying opportunity — still high risk, high reward. He would wait for more progress or a lower price before upgrading Rigetti. Calls: RGTI AVOID (first tracked call), IONQ BUY reiterated (was BUY 11 Nov, FV ~$54).
